The '''Seltaine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Irishi sector/Legends|Irishi sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selnesh/Legends|Selnesh]].
